elements.content:
Box 1. Defining physical activity

Physical activity is defined as any bodily movement produced by skeletal muscles that requires energy expenditure (3) and can be done at a variety of intensities, and accumulated through work, domestic chores, transportation or during leisure time, or when participating in sport, walking, cycling, active recreation, and active play.

What is physical inactivity?
Physical inactivity is defined as doing insufficient physical activity to meet current physical activity recommendations.

What is sedentary behaviour?
Sedentary behaviour is defined as any waking behaviour while in a sitting, reclining or lying posture with low energy expenditure (4).

See the glossary for further information.

Outline icon of a running person.

Physical activity provides social, environmental and economic benefits.
